subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about winning back lapsed depositors for {Brand} as qualifying re-deposits rather than re-clicks. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the re-deposit itself, read back through a server-to-server postback via your MMP and screened for bonus abuse before payout, so you pay only for validated returning depositors at an eCPA of $120 in your licensed states. If it helps, I can pull the state-level recovery view we hold for your live markets. Open to a quick look?
angle: warm bump, restate qualifying re-deposit + S2S validation proof
illustrative_flags: eCPA of $120 on the re-deposit (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN gaming_casino retargeting: references the prior outreach in the first sentence; restates one proof point from the parent (re-deposit optimization + S2S postback validation, bonus-abuse screening); one illustrative MobUpps figure (eCPA $120); soft CTA, one question mark; no sign-off; native US English; no 'X, not Y' (parent 'rather than' kept once).
